notes.text: The slide lists New York City and North California as separate rows under their hubs. They are treated as carve-outs: the hub 02 team covers the rest of the hub (NYC excluded), and the hub 16 team covers the rest of hub 16 (North California excluded).
American Samoa, Marshall Islands, and Micronesia are not in the hub 16 name on the slide, but the Subs/Annuity file places them in hub 16, so they were added there.

The source splits New York, Pennsylvania, California, Florida, and Texas into sub-areas but does not define the boundaries. The map shades these states as partial coverage and the panel names the sub-area.
Spelling differs between the org chart and the territory table for Lawrence Reed ("Lawrance" on the org chart) and Syed Jaffar Zaidi ("Syed J Zaidi"). The territory table spelling is used.
"Brain Gerber" is shown as written on the TSS table. It may be a typo for Brian Gerber. Confirm before sharing.
Gabe Solano (ELH) appears on the BTS (AI) org chart and an OPEN seat appears on the BTS (Data) org chart, but neither has a hub on the territory table, so neither is on the map.
The TSS (open) seats are New York City and the rest of hub 16 (California south, Guam, Hawaii, Northern Mariana Islands, and the Pacific islands).
Select-T names are spelled differently across slides: Allison/Alison Hirst, Chris Tofalli/Toffali, and Vince Abbatiello/Abbatielo. The Build Select-T coverage map spelling is used.

Washington, D.C., is not drawn on the Select-T map. It is assigned to Alison Wylie (Southeast) to match hub 03. Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and the Pacific territories have no Select-T IPS owner on the map.
Cerium Networks LLC has no headquarters state in Sheet1, so it is listed but not placed on the map.

Spelling cleaned up in Ecosystem_coverage.xlsx: "Collin Stiffler" to "Colin Stiffler"; "Danniel Benner" to "Daniel Benner"; "Isha Desia" to "Isha Desai"; "Sam Curuso" to "Sam Caruso"; "Surjeet Dey" to "Surajeet Dey"; "Vigina" to "Virginia". "Colin" and "Surajeet" follow the most common or most recent spelling, so confirm them.
Data PTS and BPS people are mapped to the states where the partners they cover are headquartered. A partner's HQ is not the area its people work in, so treat this layer as a footprint.
Partners marked "VAD covered" have no named 2026 Data PTS (the distributor covers them). "Pathway" in the 2025 PTS column looks like a program name, not a person, so it is shown as text.
A partner headquartered in New York, Pennsylvania, California, Florida, or Texas has no sub-area on file, so the whole state is shaded for its Data PTS and BPS.
The Subs/Annuity file lists emails only. Names were read from First.Last emails; 11 sellers have a single-word alias, so the alias is shown as written.
Seller coverage names such as "ACT CORE IND" are kept as written (C&D, IND, PUB, FSS, GRW, OTH). They are not expanded because the file does not define them.

The product view slide groups products under AI/BA and Data and data security. BTS (AI) is matched to AI/BA and BTS (Data) to Data and data security, following the org chart (AI productivity versus data and data security). "Guardium AI Protection" appears twice on the slide and is listed once.
